description: Piekary Śląskie: Infrastruktura rowerowa: ścieżki rowerowe is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Piekary Śląskie. Zbiór danych obejmuje ścieżki rowerowe na terenie gminy. Wykaz zawiera miejsce początkowe i końcowe ścieżki, długość i przebieg trasy, ew. stopień trudności oraz datę ostatniej modyfikacji przebiegu trasy. Coverage: Piekary Śląskie. The publisher named on the listing is Piekary Śląskie. Its keywords include trasy rowerowe, ścieżki rowerowe, infrastruktura rowerowa, drogi rowerowe. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2025-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
